title: Mid-level QA Engineer
description: Mid-level QA automation engineer capable of independently designing Page Object Model test frameworks in Playwright/Cypress, authoring REST Assured API test suites, configuring k6 performance scenarios, verifying OWASP defenses, integrating automated suites into CI/CD pipelines, and quarantining flaky tests.

skills.rationale: Architecting maintainable Page Object Model suites, intercepting network traffic, and eliminating flakiness with explicit waiting strategies.
Building robust API test automation suites with REST Assured / Newman, chaining dynamic tokens, and validating JSON schema contracts.
Integrating test automation into CI/CD pipelines, generating Allure reports, and managing flaky test quarantine workflows.
Writing k6 load scripts, profiling stress/soak testing profiles, and validating OWASP Top 10 defenses during quality gates.
Applying Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning, and Decision Tables to design optimized test matrices.
Conducting regression impact analysis, unscripted exploratory testing tours, and cross-browser matrix verification.
Handling CSR vs SSR hydration timing in tests, manipulating client storage/cookies, and testing responsive device viewports.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is sum divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.label: Not Ready
not_ready.description: Significant gaps in test automation, POM architecture, or API automation frameworks.

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Competent with simple automation scripts, but struggles with test flakiness, request chaining, or CI pipeline gating.

approaching.label: Approaching Ready
approaching.description: Strong test automation design, reliable Page Object models, independent API testing, and solid grasp of k6 load testing.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Meets all mid-level expectations: delivers stable cross-browser and API automation suites in CI/CD, tracks quality metrics, and executes performance profiles.

exceeds.label: Exceeds Expectations
exceeds.description: Exceeds mid-level expectations with advanced contract testing (Pact), distributed load generation, and visual regression leadership.
